Legislation

New legislation is considered by the County Council at the regularly scheduled bi-monthly Council Meetings. The public is encouraged to attend all meetings of the Council and sign up ahead of time to testify on general matters or on specific legislation during public hearings. Council Meetings begin at 7:00 p.m.
